title: Experimental verification of halomethyl carbinol synthesis from carbonyl compounds using a TiCl4–Mg bimetallic complex promoter
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39609-39617
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07250B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Olga Michalak, Sylwia Żurawicka, Marek Kubiszewski, Piotr Krzeczyński, Andrzej Leś, Sławomir Filipek, Marcin Cybulski
A mechanism for the formation of vicinal 1,2-diols in the presence of a bimetallic TiCl4–Mg promoter is proposed, supported by the analysis of experimental data (twelve examples) and theoretical DFT calculations (DFT/B3LYP).
